name: Capability Proposal

title: "[CAPABILITY] "
labels: ["capability", "integration"]

---

**Capability Name**
Name of the tool, repository, or capability.

**Upstream Repository**
GitHub repository URL: `https://github.com/owner/repo`

**License**
Open-source license (must be OSI-approved, e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD):

**Proposed Pinned Commit SHA**
Exact 40-character hexadecimal Git commit SHA from the repository:
`e.g., a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9012345678`

**Role & Problem Solved**
What distinct engineering gap does this capability address that existing capabilities (ECC, Graphify, Unlazy, Addy, Agency, gstack, OpenDesign, Ponytail, Karpathy) do not?

**Proposed Routing Priority & Triggers**
- Suggested Priority (1–100):
- Activation Triggers / Keywords:
- Default State: (e.g., Conditional, On-demand, Explicit-only)

**Host Support**
- [ ] Codex supported
- [ ] Antigravity supported
- [ ] Claude Code supported
- [ ] CLI / external standalone tool

**Verification Checklist**
- [ ] The upstream capability does NOT require MCP or `.mcp.json`
- [ ] The upstream capability will remain an external reference (NO vendoring)
- [ ] The repository has proven quality and active maintenance
